job.title: Compatibility
job.jdText: CompatibilityWorking at Stripe is not for everyone Not everyone finds success at Stripe. Those who do tend to share a few things in common. The right people donât always think theyâre right Successful Stripes are rigorous thinkers who appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. We want people who are not afraid to be wrong, who can enthusiastically back proposals they initially opposed, and who know how to support decisions with numbers and narrative. We operate in situations of substantial uncertainty and cannot afford either timidity or recklessness. The global financial system can seem like a mystifying domain. It isnât. Itâs made of people and computers, like many other systems youâve worked on. Most Stripes donât come from finance, and theyâve thrived by bringing fresh perspectives. We want generalists who can parachute anywhere into our operations, learn a new field quickly, and execute competently beyond their formal remit. We know that we canât be successful without nurturing the careers of both generalists and experts. People who thrive in high-conflict work environments often do not enjoy the experience here. We try to embrace kindness while still encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Who is Stripe for? Ambitious builders Weâre building solutions without clear precedent, solving problems with far-reaching consequences. The people here find that energizing, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Adaptable problem solvers AI is changing how the global economy works, how our customers work, and how Stripes work. The people who thrive here adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. Rigorous thinkers We argue from first principles, question assumptions, and donât stop at good enough. At Stripe, craft isnât a nice-to-haveâitâs the standard. The most successful Stripes are the people who have the intellectual horsepower, the curiosity to learn a very complicated business, and the humility to get up every day and realize thereâs a huge amount of things they donât know. Conor McNamaraHead of EMEA What all Stripes have in common Weâre dedicated to our work and optimistic about the world. We believe entrepreneurship and free markets do good, and building what supports them matters. If thatâs you, read on. Motivated by our mission Stripe is on a mission to grow the GDP of the internet. Ask Yourself: Do I see free markets and entrepreneurship as powerful forces for advancing progress? Does enabling entrepreneurship and helping to unlock the internet economyâs full potential seem like a compelling use of my time and talents? Embody our operating principles âUsers firstâ is a cornerstone principle. Our users trust us to provide an essential service, and itâs a heavy responsibility that we take very seriously. Ask Yourself: Am I motivated to move mountains to protect and support businesses that depend on Stripe? Am I driven to overcome obstacles and take on big things to drive progress, or do I feel overwhelmed by the sheer scale and breadth of sometimes nebulous opportunities? Energized by change The pace of change at Stripe and in the broader economy is accelerating. Youâll work outside your domain, take on problems that didnât exist a year ago, and be expected to adapt as quickly as the world does. Ask Yourself: Do I see a fast-moving environment as an opportunity rather than an obstacle? Am I comfortable taking on problems outside my domain or experience? Collaborative, multidisciplinary work Building programmable financial infrastructure from first principles is inherently complex. It means that everything we create requires deep, collaborative, multidisciplinary work: technically, organizationally, and geographically. Ask Yourself: Am I excited by navigating complexity at scale? How we operate Youâll bring high standards to everything you do and find others who do the same. Users first We serve millions of businesses and a meaningful fraction of global GDP. We have a weighty responsibility to those businesses and to society. We work backwards from our usersâ needs, indexing especially on feedback from the most innovative. Everyone at Stripe talks to users. Create with craft and beauty With careful thought, anything can be made surprisingly great. Across every part of Stripe, we are committed to doing so. Well-crafted work indicates care for the user, and beautiful work indicates care for the world. Move with urgency and focus We move with speed on what matters most and take the time to invest in what will make us faster tomorrow. Whereas many companies get slower until theyâre eventually mired in mediocrity, we aspire to become the worldâs fastest company. Collaborate egolessly We work as one team: no fiefdoms, no hoarding information, no ânot my problem.â We question assumptions, debate energetically, and abandon ideas when better ones emerge. Weâre generous with credit and stingy with blame. We learn from mistakes together. Stay curious Stripe is an applied exercise in learning about how businesses tick and how the world works. Since the details and possibilities are infinite, we are always seeking to learn. Weâre energized by the unfamiliar, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Obsess over talent Itâs every Stripeâs responsibility to help hire the best and to push for excellence everywhere. Managers must relentlessly uphold our high talent bar, lead their teams with clarity and context, foster development, and ultimately support Stripes in accomplishing the best work of their careers. Our culture Like all great workplaces, Stripe has its own working culture, with norms that can surprise, delight, and occasionally perplex. Friday Fireside Friday Fireside is a weekly Stripe-wide forum hosted by Patrick and John. We hear from a Stripe user and get their unvarnished feedback, invite Stripes to chat about (or demo!) their recent work, and welcome external experts to discuss timely and relevant topics. Convergence Every December, Stripes come together for Convergenceâa full-day event and Stripe tradition dating back to 2014. Itâs a chance to reflect on the past year, hear about our priorities for the next year, learn from each other, and poke fun at ourselves. How we show up in the world Cheeky Pint Ideas meet the pub hang. In this podcast series, John Collison sits down with founders, builders, and leaders to discuss their craft over a pint. Watch Cheeky Pint Stripe Press Stripe Press publishes books about ideas for economic, technological, and scientific progress. We print works we think can be broadly useful. Find Stripe Press titles Works in Progress Stripeâs online and print magazine focuses on scientific, technological and economic advancement. Read about Works in Progress Frontier Launched in 2022, Frontier is Stripeâs advance market commitment to buy an initial $1.8B of permanent carbon removal by 2040. Learn about Frontier Intercept A new initiative focused on dramatically reducing the burden of respiratory viruses. Learn about Intercept Frequently asked questions What is it actually like to work at Stripe day to day? Fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and creative. The volume is high, and the problems are high stakes. But you wonât be doing it aloneâwe work with egoless collaboration. Most Stripes will tell you the caliber of their teammates is one of the things they value most, and that it raises their own standard of work. How does Stripe invest in your growth? Through the work itself, mostly. Stripe gives people stretch projects early, which means youâre solving problems that are hard and consequential to the business. Beyond that, we offer mentorship, direct feedback, and an annual education stipend for courses, conferences, and resources that move your career forward. The expectation is that youâll grow quickly here. Weâre set up to support you. How does AI shape the work here? AI is embedded in how everyone at Stripe builds, analyzes, and operates. Engineers use AI tools daily to accelerate development. Teams across product, design, and operations are building AI-powered features for the businesses and consumers who rely on Stripe. We think carefully about where AI creates real value versus where it introduces risk. What does it mean to do your best work here? Stripe is a place to do career-defining work. The stakes are high: millions of businesses rely on Stripe. Itâs a responsibility that requires combining urgency with high standards, an often demanding mix. In exchange, you'll have the support and opportunity to pursue big ideas and change how things work, with a high degree of autonomy. More on careers at Stripe Get our perspective on why what we build matters. Opportunity Start your career at the center of the global economyâsee what we offer for early career opportunities. Emerging talent Weâre hiring. Explore our open roles and submit your application. Regional General Manager, Airports As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region. This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience. The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience. Key Deliverables Include Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results. Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities. Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans. Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions. Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region. Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations. Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations. Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders. Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives. Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results. Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels. Post-secondary education with a business application an asset. Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously. Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook. Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time. Project management skills considered an asset. Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset. Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams. IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job. Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency. About The Role The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. This is a customer-facing, hands-on implementation role combining project management, system configuration, payroll-process understanding, customer training and cross-functional coordination. The Onboarding Manager works closely with customers, in collaboration with the partnerâs Implementation Managers and internal Connecteam teams to ensure employee data, time tracking, PTO, payroll rules and payroll system integrations are configured and validated correctly. The primary goal is to deliver a smooth onboarding experience while ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time. Implementations are payroll-first and planned around the customerâs first clock-in date, payroll schedule and go-live timeline. job.jdText: About PulseMediaNL PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. Position Overview The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems. Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission. Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity. Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries. Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation. Perform routine data quality checks and audits. Generate reports and summaries as requested by management. Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms. Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations. Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information. Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy. Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage. Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred. Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy. Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word. Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs. Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems. Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CRM or ERP software. Familiarity with database management systems. Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices. Experience working remotely in a professional environment. Basic analytical and problem-solving skills. Key Skills Data entry accuracy Time management Organization Attention to detail Communication Problem-solving Computer literacy Multitasking Confidentiality Team collaboration What We Offer Fully remote work environment. Competitive salary. Flexible working schedule where applicable. Paid time off and company holidays. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. Supportive and collaborative team culture. Ongoing training and skill development. Performance recognition and advancement opportunities. Access to modern digital collaboration tools. Success in This Role The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes. Equal Opportunity Employer PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities. If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.
